amazon_rekognition_new_face_trigger.description: Runs each time a face is added to a collection in Amazon Rekognition. Ones added to a collection before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

amazon_rekognition_new_or_changed_face_t.description: Runs each time a face is added or changes in Amazon Rekognition. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

amazon_rekognition_new_or_changed_user_t.description: Runs each time a user is added or changes in Amazon Rekognition. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

amazon_rekognition_new_user_trigger.description: Runs each time a user is added to a collection in Amazon Rekognition. Ones added to a collection before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
